title: GPU infrastructure decision, April 2025
text: AsterCloud A40 is the approved GPU option for the Data Ninjas. The plan supports a 900 GPU-hour monthly workload below a ceiling of EUR 3000. This decision was replaced in September 2026.

title: Current compute procurement policy
text: For new project workloads, the currently authorised accelerator service is GreenCompute L40S hosted in the European Union. Providers must document data retention and deletion. Earlier A40 decisions are superseded.

title: GreenCompute L40S teaching offer
text: GreenCompute offers L40S capacity for EUR 2.85 per GPU-hour. A workload of 900 GPU-hours costs EUR 2565 before optional storage. Processing takes place in an EU region.

title: AsterCloud A40 offer
text: AsterCloud offers A40 GPU resources for approved research teams. The quoted price is EUR 2.40 per GPU-hour. The offer expired before the current procurement policy took effect.

title: Data Ninjas meeting note
text: The team likes the AsterCloud interface and would prefer the cheaper A40 offer if procurement allowed it. This note records an opinion and does not authorise a provider.

title: Retention and deletion requirements
text: Infrastructure providers must state the processing region, retention period, and deletion procedure. Confidential notes may not be included in public event descriptions or vendor support tickets.

title: CampusCritters brand composition rules
text: Generated creatures may use approved colours and motifs. Official logos, exact text, and typography are added with deterministic layout code after image generation.

title: Unapproved procurement draft
text: Draft proposal: compare AsterCloud A40 with future H100 capacity. Prices, retention conditions, and approval status remain unresolved. Do not treat this draft as a decision.
